hypothesis_zh: 修正针孔后的 GEO-01 输入使用多供体限幅中位数水纹，可增加水面细节且逐像素保留牛轭湖拓扑、封堵、岸线和陆地。
single_variable_zh: 相对修正后的程序底图只增加模型派生的受限中高频材质；程序水体拓扑、边界、封堵与陆地不变。

control_override_explanations.sparse_identity_boundary: 由 build_control.py 直接复制修正后的 geo01_water_boundary；不从成图反推。

prompt_parts.scene_identity: Top-down macro photograph of calm natural blue river water, edge-to-edge material sample
prompt_parts.material_goal: fine irregular surface ripples, subtle reflections, low-contrast natural water texture
prompt_parts.state_delta: uniform material swatch without banks or focal objects
prompt_parts.must_preserve: even texture scale, no shoreline, no text

negative_artifacts: shoreline, river bank, island, sandbar, boats, plants, fish, stones, concentric rings, point sources, panels, seams, dividing lines, text, labels, arrows, user interface, watermark, giant waves, plastic, metal, perspective, horizon, blur
